events.title: The Playtest is now LIVE!
events.summary: We are proud to present to you the first public version of Counter Ducks! It includes two playable maps: Ducks Eye Lake and Gator Swamp. Currently and temporarily, the game can be played with a maximum of 8 people in any team configuration (4v4, 3v5, etc.). events.title: Public Playtest Sign-ups Are Now Open!
events.summary: We're getting ready to launch the first public playtest of Counter Ducks, and you can sign up starting today! To celebrate, here's a quick look at the chaotic action waiting for you. Whether you choose to fight as a duck or a hunter, expect plenty of explosions, teamwork, and hilarious moments. Which side would you choose first: Ducks or Hunters? Join Discord! https://discord.com/invite/4zHtPbGneT
